description: ls20 FLASH-ONSET-GUIDED attention (block 223000): tests the owner's claim that the avatar<->shape flash is a salience indicator of the rules. Flash detection = the EXISTING onset stream (photon_transduce_onset + retinal_onset_2d), NOT a bespoke detector. This seed adds only fg_pick_flash: Argmax(magnitude_db) over the FlashOnset cues -> the attended flash location. The flash is a POINTER (where/when), distinct from the persistent TRANSFORM (what) still discovered by the identical 222000 sd-loop; the flash appearance is identical for all actions. Guarded on flash_on==1 (default-OFF, byte-identical otherwise), the arm, and the attend_flash phase (distinct from every pc_* phase). No Rust; reuses Argmax + the whole ls20_percell machinery.
